title: Fifty Bananas

pre.en: Why did the narrator get fifty bananas?
pre.zh: 叙述者为什么收到了五十根香蕉？
options: He wanted to bake banana bread.
Tom asked him to buy them.
The café downstairs gave them to him.
He typed the wrong number by mistake.

intro: 一篇小故事：一次半夜下错的单，让「我」家里堆满了香蕉。故事从「现在」讲起，再倒回下单的那个晚上。读的时候留意两种完成时：现在完成进行时（have been doing）说一直在做、还没停的过程；现在完成时（have done）说做完了多少、有了什么结果。

sentences.en: So, I've been eating bananas for five days now.
sentences.zh: 是这样，我已经连着吃了五天香蕉了。

sentences.en: Breakfast, lunch and dinner.
sentences.zh: 早饭、午饭、晚饭，顿顿都是。

sentences.en: And I still haven't finished them.
sentences.zh: 可还是没吃完。

sentences.en: On Sunday night, I was ordering food online, half asleep, and I typed 50 instead of 5 by mistake.
sentences.zh: 周日晚上，我迷迷糊糊地在网上买菜，一不小心把 5 打成了 50。

sentences.en: The next morning, the lift was broken — again — and a delivery man carried an enormous box all the way up the stairs.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，电梯又坏了，送货小哥扛着一个巨大的箱子，一路爬楼梯送上来。

sentences.en: Fifty bananas.
sentences.zh: 五十根香蕉。

sentences.en: My kitchen is tiny, and ripe bananas go off really fast.
sentences.zh: 我的厨房小得可怜，熟透的香蕉又坏得特别快。

sentences.en: I had to get rid of them, and quickly.
sentences.zh: 我得把它们处理掉，还得赶紧。

sentences.en: Since then, I've been trying to give them away.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，我一直在想办法把它们送出去。

sentences.en: Tom's been taking a few to his restaurant, and the café downstairs has taken plenty of them for its smoothies.
sentences.zh: Tom 这几天一直往他的餐馆带几根，楼下的咖啡馆也拿了不少去做果昔。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, I left a note in the lift: "Free bananas — help yourself!"
sentences.zh: 周二，我在电梯里贴了张字条：「免费香蕉——随便拿！」

sentences.en: All week, neighbours I didn't even know have been knocking on my door.
sentences.zh: 这一个星期，好多我压根不认识的邻居都来敲我的门。

sentences.en: So far, I've given away thirty.
sentences.zh: 到现在，我已经送出去三十根了。

sentences.en: Last night, I ended up baking banana bread.
sentences.zh: 昨晚，我最后干脆烤起了香蕉面包。

sentences.en: An old roll of baking paper from the back of a cupboard came in really handy.
sentences.zh: 柜子最里面翻出来的一卷旧烘焙纸，这下可派上大用场了。

sentences.en: The smell has taken over the whole building, and yes, I've made a terrible mess.
sentences.zh: 整栋楼都是那股香味，没错，我也把厨房弄得一塌糊涂。

sentences.en: I've baked two loaves so far.
sentences.zh: 到现在已经烤了两条了。

sentences.en: Tomorrow: banana pancakes.
sentences.zh: 明天的节目：香蕉松饼。

sentences.en: The funny thing is, for the first time, I really feel at home here.
sentences.zh: 好笑的是，我头一回在这儿真正有了家的感觉。

sentences.en: Yesterday, the woman from upstairs knocked on my door with a bag.
sentences.zh: 昨天，楼上的一位女士提着一个袋子来敲我的门。

sentences.en: "I ordered too many eggs by mistake," she said.
sentences.zh: 「我不小心订多了鸡蛋，」她说。

sentences.en: "Could you take a few?"
sentences.zh: 「你能帮忙拿几个吗？」

cards.note: 第 1 课学过 fast asleep（睡得很熟）；half asleep 是困得迷迷糊糊、还没完全睡着。
without intending to, because of an error
cards.tip: 第 2 课是点错了咖啡，这里是打错了数字；反义说法是 on purpose（故意）。
cards.example: I deleted the wrong branch by mistake.

cards.note: 动词是 deliver；外卖也叫 food delivery；送货员也可以说 delivery driver。
没熟的是 unripe；香蕉熟透了还可以说 overripe，正适合做香蕉面包。
(of food) to become bad and no longer good to eat
cards.tip: 英式说法，过去分词是 gone off；美式多说 go bad。go off 还能指闹钟「响」：My alarm went off at six。
cards.example: Don't drink that milk — I think it's gone off.

cards.note: to throw away, sell or give away something you do not want
cards.tip: of 后面接想扔掉、想摆脱的东西：get rid of old files；也能说摆脱问题：get rid of a bug。
cards.example: I finally got rid of my old laptop.

cards.note: to give something to someone for free
cards.tip: 代词放中间：give them away。give away 还有「泄露（秘密）」的意思：Don't give away the ending!
cards.example: The company gave away free T-shirts at the conference.

cards.note: a lot of; more than enough
cards.tip: 后面接可数名词复数或不可数名词都行：plenty of bananas / plenty of time；带「足够、还有富余」的意思。
cards.example: Don't worry, we have plenty of time before the demo.

cards.note: 用水果加酸奶或牛奶打成的饮料；milkshake 是加冰淇淋的奶昔。
to write a short message and put it somewhere for someone to find
cards.tip: 第 1 课是给楼下邻居留字条道歉，这里是给全楼的人留言；leave 的过去式是 left。
cards.example: I left a note on her desk to say I'd be late.

cards.note: to take food or drink without waiting for someone to serve you
to be in a place or situation in the end, often without planning it
cards.tip: 后面接 doing 或地点：end up doing sth / end up in Paris，常带「本来没打算这样」的意思。
cards.example: We ended up working until midnight.

cards.note: a roll of tape / toilet paper；作动词是「滚动」。
垫在烤盘上防粘的纸，美式叫 parchment paper。
to be useful, especially when you did not expect it to be
cards.tip: handy 是形容词「有用的、方便的」，不能写成 come in hand。留着旧东西时常说 It might come in handy.（说不定用得上。）
cards.example: Those Swift notes came in handy during the interview.

cards.note: to take control of something from someone else
to make a place dirty or untidy, or to do something very badly
复数是 loaves，f 变成 v 加 es，同类的还有 knife – knives、shelf – shelves。
to feel comfortable and relaxed in a place
cards.tip: feel at home in + 地方。第 6 课 Chen 说 it took me a while to feel at home，说的是这座城市；这一课是在这栋楼里，因为终于认识了邻居。
cards.example: After a month, I started to feel at home in the new team.
